company.name: UH.APP
company.shortDescription: UH.APP (United Hunters Application) provides a comprehensive solution for representing legal hunting society on the internet
company.description:
UH.APP (United Hunters App) is the world’s first all-in-one digital ecosystem for the global hunting community — a cross-platform Super App available in 35 languages, tailored for 50+ million enthusiasts of hunting, fishing, and outdoor life.
Built as a modular meta-system of microservices, UH.APP seamlessly combines a social network, media hub, booking service, marketplace, knowledge library, and more — empowering users from falconers in the Middle East to horseback hunters in rural Europe.
With no unified digital space for this $100B+ industry — until now — UH.APP sets out to lead as the #1 global platform connecting individuals, brands, outfitters, conservationists, and organizations across the world.
